case-study.name: Case study package
case-study.use: One client story told everywhere at once: social, story, blog, deck, a one-pager, the full case study PDF and an announcement email.

outputs.brief: Two feed posts, each with its caption: the headline result as a stat post, then the client's quote or the problem they solved.
One story with the headline result and a short line pointing to the full case study.
The story as a blog post (impact type unless the piece says otherwise): challenge, what changed, results, the client's words.
A short case study deck for a sales conversation: title, at a glance, challenge, what they did, results, quote, close.
The one-pager: at a glance stats, two or three short sections, a small closing card.
The full case study PDF (3 to 5 pages): at a glance, organization, challenge, what they did, results with a table or chart, what made it work, closing card.
An announcement email (template: announcement) introducing the case study, with one call to action to read it.

demo-follow-up.name: Demo follow-up package
demo-follow-up.use: What a prospect gets after a demo: a takeaway PDF on the specific ways the product helps them and the next steps, and a follow-up email.

outputs.brief: A multipage takeaway: what we heard, the specific ways we can help (one section each), next steps as a numbered list, closing card with the contact.
A personal follow-up email (template: letter) thanking them for their time, naming the two or three points that mattered most, and one call to action for the next step.
